title: fix(theme): the theme toggle says Dark while it follows the system
body:
With the preference on System and the phone in dark mode, `components/ThemeToggle.tsx` labels itself "Dark", so it is not clear the app is following the system.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The toggle reads System whenever the preference is System
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
why: No Size on the board or in the body: the skill estimates one, says so, and proceeds.
